rule: one row per zero-claim region of the 2026-11-18 cloud deep-forest pass. verdict: CONFIRMED (terms read and quoted, machine reuse allowed), BLOCKED_ON_TERMS (terms refuse or are UNREAD -- unread counts as a refusal, LAWS 5e act 6), HARD_STOP (a wall/challenge or 401/403/429/451: never bypassed), NO_CALENDAR (terms allow but no publication time can be stamped). `built` names the regions research/release_calendar_states.py fetches; it fetches nothing else.
how_read: terms and robots pages were read through a page reader from the build container (its proxy refuses these hosts to curl). The organ's live gate re-reads robots.txt on the box with the honest UA before any data request and fails closed
